findings.title: Helper snapshots later bytes than those it actually validated
findings.observation: attempt_ok is read at1310, check_live/reconciliation runs1312, and source_provenance validates committed/working contents1313-1315. Only afterward does verification_files enumerate inputs and stamp/hash them1318-1325. No prevalidation stamp/digest is compared to those later bytes. Parent checks later stamps, private version and digest length, then dispatches with cached attempt_ok; check_live returns immediately whenever this verification is supplied.
findings.failing_interleaving: A valid attemptN is read true. During helper reconciliation/provenance, Orchestrator increments the external run_state attempt toN+1. Hashing now records the stable new state and its stamp. Supervisor version has not changed, and parent stamp checks pass on those same new bytes. verified_attempt returns cached true and submit-operation sends execution charged to stale attemptN. Similarly a previously validated operation/source file changed before the later snapshot can be accepted as though the new bytes were validated.
findings.contract_conflict: Preserve live contract/step/attempt and crash-disagreement/source continuity guards; full reviewed S2 snapshot must bind bytes actually validated and recheck current identities/live attempt before applying. External file edits do not advance self.version.
findings.required_resolution: Make semantic checks operate on the exact snapshot being certified, and ensure current attempt/input identity is still valid at publication. Validator supplies no repair or execution authority.

findings.title: Growing valid history eventually disables cancellation and close
findings.observation: verification_files includes every operation and result forever. Every successful helper response serializes a full path/stamp/SHA row per file. send replaces any encoded response larger than FRAME_LIMIT65536 with infrastructure failure. There is no history bound, paging or bounded summary. client_event requires this job for every non-poll action, including cancel-operation and close-session.
findings.failure: A sufficiently long otherwise valid completed history necessarily exceeds the response ceiling. From that point cancel/close/reattach/transfer/new admission cannot reach dispatch. A just-admitted pending operation whose publication crosses that size boundary cannot be cancelled through the API: the helper failure occurs before cancel_requested publication and deadline arming. Idle sessions also cannot close normally. This is a deterministic growth boundary, independent of scheduler speed or hostile input.
findings.contract_conflict: Preserve seven calls, original operation/history and cancellation invariants while moving full reconciliation off the event loop. Bounded helper transport must not make safety calls unavailable as legal durable history grows.
findings.required_resolution: Retain complete history validation with a bounded communication/admission design that continues to permit cancellation and observed group shutdown. Validator supplies no repair or execution authority.
findings.evidence: .agent/evidence/129/mode-b1/static1.stdout.txt includes exact history enumeration, response-size replacement and action-routing lines.
